description: This file defines the MessageMapperFactory interface responsible for creating MessageMapper instances and MessageMapperRegistry objects based on provided MappingContext and PayloadMappingDefinition configurations.

classes.name: MessageMapperFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating MessageMapper instances and MessageMapperRegistry objects based on MappingContext information.

methods.name: mapperOf
methods.description: Creates a MessageMapper instance for a given ID and context, returning Optional.empty() if none is available.

methods.name: registryOf
methods.description: Creates a MessageMapperRegistry based on the default context and provided payload mapping definitions.
